sources.title: zerofata/G4-MeroMero-v2-31B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A finetune of Gemma 4 31B designed for creative tasks, particularly narrative RP. Intended to be a more creative version of G4-MeroMero-31B. This model is the result of a lot of experimentation and learning. Trying to make Gemma 4 more creative without destroying the intelligence is... difficult. To put it mildly. Heavily inspired by a few research papers, StoryScope: Investigating ...

sources.title: zerofata/G4-MeroMero-31B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A finetune of Gemma 4 31B designed for creative tasks. Another difficult to work with but extremely good model from Google. This model has a slightly better swipe diversity and a less flowery / verbose writing style. Reasoning tends to average out being a bit longer than the original however. Intelligence appears to be on par with the original. Supports both thinking and non thinking.

sources.title: Architecture graph for zerofata/G4-MeroMero-v2-31B | hfviewer
sources.snippet: zerofata/G4-MeroMero-v2-31B architecture at a glance zerofata/G4-MeroMero-v2-31B is a model (gemma4_text architecture). It uses 60 transformer layers, a hidden size of 5,376, and 32 query heads with 16 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use an intermediate size of 21,504.
